-- Read-only current runtime identity projection for automatic-dispatch.ts:67-86,238-253.
-- Does not invoke ensureRecordedBotHarnessRuntime or perform any row lock/write.
WITH task_scope AS (
  SELECT id, "userId", "issueId", "botId", "candidateId"
  FROM factory_tasks WHERE id='e42571e5-58f7-40e3-9418-c02ee8843fe6'::uuid
), producer_source AS (
  SELECT t.*, f.position AS "sourcePosition", r.id AS "sourceRunId",
    r."agentId" AS "sourceAgentId", r."deviceId" AS "sourceDeviceId",
    d.kind AS "sourceDeviceKind", repo."remoteUrl" AS "sourceRemoteUrl",
    cb."botId" AS "runtimeBotId", cb."workspaceId" AS "runtimeWorkspaceId",
    r."agentDefinition"#>>'{executionIdentity,workspaceId}' AS "sourceExecutionWorkspace"
  FROM task_scope t
  JOIN factory_attempts f ON f."taskId"=t.id AND f.stage IN ('execute','spec')
  JOIN agent_runs r ON r.id=f."runId"
  JOIN agents a ON a.id=r."agentId"
  JOIN devices d ON d.id=r."deviceId"
  JOIN device_repos repo ON repo.id=r."deviceRepoId"
  LEFT JOIN computer_run_bindings cb ON cb."runId"=r.id AND cb."ownerId"=r."userId"
  ORDER BY f.position DESC LIMIT 1
), old_checks AS (
  SELECT a.stage,r.id AS "runId",r."agentId",r."deviceId",
    d.kind AS "deviceKind",r."agentDefinition"->>'harness' AS harness,
    r."agentDefinition"#>>'{executionIdentity,workspaceId}' AS "executionWorkspace"
  FROM task_scope t JOIN factory_attempts a ON a."taskId"=t.id
  JOIN agent_runs r ON r.id=a."runId" AND r."userId"=t."userId" AND r."issueId"=t."issueId"
  JOIN devices d ON d.id=r."deviceId" AND d."ownerId"=r."userId"
  WHERE a.id IN ('41e41625-f1e2-4b2d-9d62-9fecbc4d62ae'::uuid,
                 'aa77cb0b-bb48-4c7a-ab73-ad68e7df7dba'::uuid)
)
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS "observedAt", s."sourceRunId", s."sourcePosition",
  s."sourceAgentId", s."sourceDeviceKind", s."runtimeBotId",s."runtimeWorkspaceId",
  s."sourceExecutionWorkspace", (s."sourceRemoteUrl" IS NULL) AS "noRepositorySource",
  o.stage,o."runId" AS "frozenRunId",o."agentId" AS "frozenAgentId",o.harness,
  (o."deviceKind"=s."sourceDeviceKind") AS "deviceKindsMatch",
  (o."executionWorkspace"=COALESCE(s."runtimeWorkspaceId"::text,s."sourceExecutionWorkspace")) AS "workspaceMatchesProducer",
  (b.id IS NOT NULL) AS "botOwnedInRuntimeWorkspace", (b."archivedAt" IS NULL) AS "botNotArchived",
  (desk."botId" IS NOT NULL) AS "desktopRecordExists",
  m.state AS "parentState",m."runtimeReady",m."deviceId" AS "currentParentDeviceId",
  d.kind AS "parentDeviceKind",d.enabled AS "parentDeviceEnabled",
  cr."agentId" AS "currentRuntimeAgentId",cr."repoId" AS "currentRuntimeRepoId",
  (cr."agentId"=o."agentId") AS "runtimeAgentMatchesFrozen",
  (ra.id IS NOT NULL) AS "runtimeAgentOwnedAndHarnessMatches",
  (ra."deviceId"=m."deviceId") AS "runtimeAgentOnCurrentParentDevice",
  (rr.id IS NOT NULL) AS "runtimeRepoOwnedOnAgentDevice",
  (COALESCE(rr."remoteUrl",rr."repoPath")=candidate.repository) AS "runtimeRepoMatchesCandidate",
  (cr."workspaceId"=s."runtimeWorkspaceId") AS "runtimeSlotWorkspaceMatches"
FROM producer_source s CROSS JOIN old_checks o
LEFT JOIN bots b ON b.id=s."runtimeBotId" AND b."ownerId"=s."userId"
  AND b."workspaceId"=s."runtimeWorkspaceId"
LEFT JOIN bot_desktops desk ON desk."botId"=b.id AND desk."ownerId"=b."ownerId" AND desk."workspaceId"=b."workspaceId"
LEFT JOIN cloud_machines m ON m."ownerId"=b."ownerId" AND m."workspaceId"=b."workspaceId"
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.id=m."deviceId" AND d."ownerId"=b."ownerId"
LEFT JOIN bot_cloud_runtimes cr ON cr."botId"=s."runtimeBotId" AND cr.harness=o.harness
  AND cr."ownerId"=s."userId" AND cr."workspaceId"=s."runtimeWorkspaceId"
LEFT JOIN agents ra ON ra.id=cr."agentId" AND ra."userId"=cr."ownerId" AND ra.harness=cr.harness
LEFT JOIN device_repos rr ON rr.id=cr."repoId" AND rr."userId"=cr."ownerId" AND rr."deviceId"=ra."deviceId"
LEFT JOIN factory_candidates candidate ON candidate.id=s."candidateId" AND candidate."taskId"=s.id
ORDER BY o.stage;
